author: icicy
body:
My username is icicy
I was banned because i made death threats
The reason you should unban me-
I was playing today. I was using a crafting table, making gear and tools. Then my teammate just breaks the crafting table. I got really mad but just put it back. Then he breaks it again. Then he starts following me when i just want to craft. So i got really mad because of this and may have said some bad things to him. I am really sorry but he really made me mad. I promise i wouldn't do anything like this again. I really enjoy playing on this server! :(

replies.author: AstroPizza
replies.body:
icicy we understand you may be annoyed in certain situations but you have to understand what is acceptable and what is not. I'm afraid we need a valid reason to appeal a valid punishment and this does not warrant one.
Appeal Denied

In the future please just use ./report and ignore the player. <3
Will lock once requested or in 24 hours

~Pizza
